Name: Strawberry Seeds From Pierre
Author: Suntooth
Description: A super simple mod that adds Strawberry Seeds to Pierre's shop in spring of year 2+, instead of having to wait for the Egg Festival.

Downloads.Description: Updated for 1.6. Shop Tile Framework is now deprecated and no longer required - the mod now only requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.

Manifest.Name: Strawberry Seeds From Pierre
Manifest.Description: Makes Pierre sell strawberry seeds from the start of Spring, starting in year 2.
Manifest.Author: Suntooth
